title: Start a page's Claude CLI only when it is needed
notes: Measured: 6 Agent SDK claude CLIs (5 projects + manager), 97-112 MB private each, 600 MB total vs 320 MB for all Electron processes; 1.0-1.24 CPU-s each at boot; SDK code holds main 420 ms of the first 3 s. Where: src/main/main.ts:456 and :640 chats.open, chat-sessions.ts start(). Fix (medium): start on first Claude screen show or worker report; stop after idle. Workers reporting to main is the constraint. Rerun: measure.mjs memory and boot. From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.

comments.body: Shipped in #186: a page's Agent SDK CLI starts the first time its Claude screen is shown, or on a prompt or worker report; a main that a restored worker reports to starts at launch. Demo memory: 6 CLIs / 621 MB before, 1 CLI / 188-194 MB after. Not done: idle stop (see PR).
